Game Overview

In Wheelie Buddy, the core idea is straightforward: master the art of wheelie riding in Wheelie Buddy. Balance skill and timing to keep your front wheel airborne and collect coins. Colorful visuals and smooth controls make each session a thrilling test of reflexes and coordination. Compete, have fun, and see how far you can go without touching down!
